subject.size_in_frame: the sustained set-up, a little closer — her face about 0.60 of frame height

second_subject.note: the fan stops inside the frame on the question and does not start again in this shot. It is the only clock in the composition and it stops.

headroom: about 0.14 of frame height, fractionally tighter than sh078 — close enough to be the same picture, tight enough that the question has less air round it.
horizon_eyeline: Same axis, lens 0.60 m; waterline at 0.88 of frame height. Her eyeline is at 0.42, out to frame left for the first half, and turns inward and unfocused on the question.

layers.fg: the fan, moving and then still, lower right

gaze.note: the same open, unoccupied left lead room as sh078 — and on 'who in the world am I?' her focus collapses into it and stops travelling. The question is composed to land in empty space.

balance: sh078's balance, tightened, and then destabilised by the fan stopping: the only counterweight on the right goes inert, leaving the face alone in frame for the last beat.
leading_lines: The waterline; the fan's arc until it ceases. When the fan stops the composition has no lines left at all, which is what the silence after the line sits in.
eye_first: Her eyes, then the fan — and the eye should notice the fan has stopped.
constraint_binding: MUST NOT BE CUT INSIDE OR ACROSS: the line must LAND AND END inside this shot with a clean line-end and clear silence after it, so the composition provides nothing that would tempt a cut — no second element, no reframe, no incoming movement — and the fan stopping inside the frame gives the edit a visible, unmistakable in-shot punctuation to hold on.
